findings.evidence: `roadmap/TauCetiRoadmap/GeometricTopology/README.md:841-875` specifies the Layer 11 link API and combinatorial-manifold target, while `rg -n "join|link"` shows no join requirement in that section; the new capability is declared at `Join/Link.lean:81,125,132`.
findings.fix: Have a human add a concrete join-based construction or theorem to the roadmap first, or retarget the PR to an existing roadmap node whose implementation demonstrably needs this formula.
findings.issue: `link_join` and its corollaries are new mathematics not required by the cited link-condition target; the roadmap asks for link, recursive sphere/ball predicates, and a vertex-link manifold predicate, but never requires joins or componentwise join calculations.

summary: The PR is a single topic, but its new join–link API has no demonstrated prerequisite path to the cited roadmap target.
